nodes.title: SG-4.1 · Pin Phaser to 3.90.x in the frontend package.json and lockfile
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/package.json declares phaser ^4.2.1 and package-lock.json resolves 4.2.1. The parent goal requires Phaser 3.90. Desired behavior: the manifest and lockfile resolve to a 3.90.x release, and the existing Phaser modules (createGame, config, BootScene, PhaserHost) compile and behave the same. Expected result: no Phaser 4 range or version remains. Why: the StoryForge redesign mandates Phaser 3.90.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given package.json, When read, Then the phaser dependency range only admits 3.90.x versions
- Given package-lock.json, When read, Then the node_modules/phaser entry and the root dependencies entry both resolve to 3.90.x
- Given the frontend modules that import phaser, When type-checked, Then they compile against 3.90 types


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/package.json
- In scope: game/frontend/package-lock.json
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/*
- Out of scope: New scenes
- Out of scope: Asset or content changes
- Out of scope: Backend
- Preserve: Event bus API
- Preserve: useGameStore shape
- Preserve: PhaserHost lifecycle behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser must be 3.90.x, not 4.x


## Definition of done
- Manifest and lockfile pin Phaser 3.90.x
- Phaser-dependent code compiles on 3.90


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · package.json and lockfile pin Phaser to 3.90.x
nodes.body:
Context: package.json has "phaser": "^4.2.1"; the lockfile resolves 4.2.1 (node_modules/phaser at about L3445, root deps at L15). Desired behavior: the range is ~3.90.0 and the lockfile resolves a 3.90.x release. Expected result: a fresh npm ci installs Phaser 3.90.x. Why: the redesign mandates Phaser 3.90.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given package.json, When dependencies.phaser is read, Then it is ~3.90.0
- Given package-lock.json, When node_modules/phaser.version is read, Then it matches 3.90.x


## Scope
- In scope: phaser entry in package.json and package-lock.json
- Out of scope: Other dependencies
- Preserve: All other dependency versions


## Technical constraints
- Lockfile must be produced by npm, not hand-edited


## Definition of done
- Both files pin 3.90.x


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Existing Phaser code compiles and runs on 3.90
nodes.body:
Context: src/phaser/createGame.ts, config.ts, BootScene.ts and components/PhaserHost.tsx use Phaser.Game, Phaser.AUTO, Phaser.Scale.FIT, Phaser.Scene and Phaser.Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, all present in 3.90. Desired behavior: these files type-check and their tests pass on 3.90 without Phaser 4-only APIs. Expected result: tsc passes and the phaser tests are green. Why: the pin must not break the app.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given Phaser 3.90 installed, When tsc --noEmit runs, Then it exits 0
- Given the src/phaser modules, When scanned, Then they reference only Phaser APIs that exist in 3.90


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/createGame.ts
- Out of scope: New features
- Preserve: Public signatures of createGame, buildGameConfig, BootScene


## Technical constraints
- Keep the pixelArt/roundPixels/FIT config


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Type-check passes
- Phaser tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
